book.title: Ioane Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Ioaneꞌa Mirihiro

content: Taruha Muiḡa Onamiro
Eꞌe enogano Iesuꞌa Galilea habaꞌano ragave onamiro. Ani Iudea habaꞌano ragavoga mene uratiro, mazaḡa eꞌea Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ani matihi radu guhine radiro.
Ebu Iuda azaḡa mui ꞌahoga, Taruha Muiḡaniꞌa hanitiro.
ꞌOugadu Iesu negoḡa duḡuruꞌa Iesu niro, “Ḡa haba ꞌahi modadu Iudea habaꞌa onamoꞌi. ꞌOugine ḡa hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ḡaeꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe haḡai gigiꞌaḡa horoniꞌuma.
Iniu ane bare vaze mazao furenihi raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe gau ꞌahoga mene sifu haḡaeꞌohe. Ḡa haḡai ꞌahiguḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, raha ꞌadi azaḡa niduꞌa mazao ḡaeꞌa bare fureꞌoꞌi.”
Iesu negoḡa duḡuruꞌa ꞌouge nirotaꞌaꞌe mazaḡa zeḡe zuni ani mene mae ḡihiniro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Izidiꞌe eḡeꞌa mene onamiteꞌe madaḡa, rehano za zae ura madaḡano onamogaꞌe idaḡa.
Raha ꞌadi azaḡaꞌe za mene heꞌeheꞌezeꞌohe, u eꞌe heꞌeheꞌeheꞌohe, mazaḡa e haḡaizeꞌe sauꞌa rae fureneꞌohe.
Za mui eꞌe veize onamoꞌi. E izidiꞌe mui eꞌe veize mene onamiꞌuma, mazaḡa eḡe madaꞌe ꞌize mene feureha.”
Ani ꞌouge rae zeadu Galilea habaꞌano radiro.
Iesu negoḡa duḡuruꞌe mui eꞌe uꞌa itiroteꞌe enogano ani vazeꞌa mene ederifine vesuꞌu sifu itiro.
Ebu Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa mui madaḡano Iesu vaḡe ragaveꞌenaꞌa, vaze eꞌea ḡadimaro, “Vaze aꞌe noumao?”
Ebu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa Iesu moneo gumudiro. Nuꞌe raenaꞌa, “Aniꞌe vaze manoḡa,” ebu nuꞌe raenaꞌa, “Mene, ani vaze soꞌozeꞌohe,” rae reiro.
Rehano ze Iuda azaḡa boroboro rihoziro ꞌahine, Iesu moneo hunio mene rae fureniro.
Kuru Neḡano Ihoziro
Mui eꞌe ḡahaꞌa hauḡirotene, Iesuꞌa kuru neḡa habaꞌa itadu vaze ḡadahe ihoziro.
ꞌOugadu Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe zaguzaganadu ꞌahige rae reiro, “Vaze ꞌadiꞌe mene hune mirihiro, rehano ani edeḡa ꞌahiguḡaꞌe nougenouge meiro?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Eḡe ihoreꞌe mene eḡe mazaonoꞌo, rehano eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡa mazaonoꞌo ariro.
Iniu Badiꞌa ura haḡaihi raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ederiꞌuma, eḡe ihoreꞌe Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo ariro ga eḡe edeḡanonoꞌo ariro.
Iniu ane edeḡano ḡoereꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe vazeꞌa ani nigunoga urateꞌohe. U ani tuḡuniroteꞌe vazeḡa nigunoga urateꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡoere huga raꞌohe zu ani mazao veꞌoḡa oꞌoꞌa.
Moseꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa za ziniro, rehano zae boꞌaḡano vaze ꞌahoga zuni eꞌe mene hegoteꞌohe. Nougadu za e uḡuhe ruhihi raꞌohe?”
Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa naenaeniro, “Vine sauꞌaniꞌa ḡa ragano reiro! Ḡa ḡame nuriꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa.”
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa Bana Madaḡano haḡai gigiꞌa ꞌahoga haḡadu zae niduꞌa zaguzagauꞌohe.

Moseꞌa ahiri rana iḡuri haḡaeꞌeteꞌe goroḡa ḡoeꞌa ziniro. (Ahiri rana iḡuri haḡaeꞌeteꞌe goroḡa ḡoeꞌaꞌe mene Moseonoꞌo, rehano ꞌizema Moseꞌa fureranogano vouḡazeonoꞌo ariro.) Eꞌanoꞌo za Bana Madaḡano zuni tahiꞌa komeꞌa ahiri rana iḡuri haḡaeꞌohe.

Za Mose goro ḡoeꞌa mene variꞌoga veize, mada tibatiba Bana Madaḡano zuni tahiꞌa komeꞌa ahiri rana iḡuri haḡaeꞌohe. Tena eḡeꞌa Bana Madaḡano vaze ꞌahoga ahiri niduꞌa fainiroteꞌe uꞌano, za nougadu eḡe mazao maḡuneꞌohe?
Zaꞌe vaze enona daꞌo ḡianadu veꞌoḡa rae ago roꞌi. Rehano huga ḡianadu duduḡa ga veꞌoḡa rae roꞌi.”
Iesuꞌe Kerisohe?
Eꞌe madaḡano Ierusalemao radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ḡadimutitiro, “Vaze ꞌadiꞌe zeꞌa matihi rae inareꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa.
Ani hunio ḡoereꞌohe, rehano ze ani rana ḡoere ꞌahoga mene raꞌohe. Iuda azaḡa boroboroꞌa zuni aniꞌe hube hune Keriso raꞌeteꞌe mae ḡihineꞌehe?
Rehano aniꞌe mene Keriso, mazaḡa eme vaze ꞌadi noumanoꞌo arirotaꞌaꞌe edeḡa. Kerisoꞌa arine, vazeni ꞌahoga zuni ani noumanoꞌo ariroteꞌe mene ederiꞌuma.”

Ebu Iesu ꞌize kuru neḡa habaꞌano ihozeꞌeteꞌea, ani ḡihau ḡoeriro, “Oꞌe, za e edeḡa ebu e noumanoꞌo arirotaꞌaꞌe edeḡa. Rehano e eḡe edeḡano mene ariro. Eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe Badiꞌaꞌe hube hune. Za ani aḡuꞌa.
U e ani edeḡa, mazaḡa eꞌe ani mazaonoꞌo ariro zu aniꞌa eḡe tuḡuhiro.”
ꞌOuge reirotene, ze Iesu obone ti nuriro, rehano vaze ꞌahoga ꞌevoꞌa hina mene oboniro, mazaḡa ani madaḡaniꞌa ꞌize mene feuriro.
Rehano vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa boꞌaḡano vaze ḡehaḡaꞌe Iesu mazao fiadu reiro, “Kerisoꞌa aradu haḡai nu badeḡa haḡaine zuni, vaze ꞌadi mene ufeta vitine haḡaiꞌuma!”
Farisea azaḡaꞌe vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa Iesu moneo ꞌouge gumude ḡoeriroteꞌe igiro. Eꞌanoꞌo dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Farisea azaḡaniꞌa Iesu obone tihi radu kuru neḡa uti azaḡa tuḡuziro.
ꞌOugadu Iesuꞌa ziro, “E zae teite mada tahiḡa daꞌo radadu eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡa vaḡe onamiꞌuma.
Za eḡe vaḡiꞌuma, rehano mene horohiꞌuma. Ebu zaꞌe eḡeꞌa radiuꞌeteꞌe habaꞌa onamogaꞌe mene idaḡa.”

Ebu Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe zeḡeꞌa bare ḡadimutitiro, “Ani noꞌe onamiꞌuma ꞌahine, eme ani mene horoniꞌuma raꞌohe? Ani Iuda azaḡaniꞌa radiuꞌeteꞌe Giriki azaḡa haba onamadu Giriki azaḡa ihoziꞌumahe?
Aniꞌa ꞌahige raꞌohe, 'Za eḡe vaḡiꞌuma, rehano mene horohiꞌuma, ebu eḡeꞌa radiuꞌeteꞌe habaꞌa aroga zuni mene idaḡa.' Eꞌe hugaꞌe nagini?”
Ḡabone Vuḡa
Mui ḡonaga madaḡaꞌe mada boro hune. Iesuꞌa edau iḡunadu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa huze ziro, “Iniu iriga moꞌoneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe vaḡe aroꞌi ebu gagoꞌi.
Buka Zaḡoḡano reiroteꞌe teige, iniu eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡabone vuḡaniꞌa vu boro teige ane zamaḡanonoꞌo sore buaꞌuma.”

Aneꞌa ḡabone vuḡa reirotaꞌaꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡa moneo rae radu iniu ani mazao fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe eꞌe hidiꞌuma rae reiro. Rehano eꞌe madaḡano Vine Zaḡoḡaꞌe ze ꞌize mene hidiro, mazaḡa Iesuꞌe ꞌize satauro rana mene rudanadu ani niꞌe mene mae ḡihiniro.
Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa ḡoere eꞌe igirotene, nuꞌe ꞌahige rae reiro, “Vaze ꞌadiꞌe hube hune peroveta vazeḡa. Aꞌe emeḡeꞌa guhineꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa.”
U vaze nuꞌe raenaꞌa, “Aniꞌe Keriso,” ebu nuꞌe raenaꞌa, “Mene, Kerisoꞌe Galilea habaꞌanonoꞌo mene ariꞌuma.
Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae reiro, 'Kerisoꞌe kini Davida mariganonoꞌo zu Davida ne Betelehemaonoꞌo ariꞌuma.'”
Eꞌanoꞌo vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaꞌe Iesu uꞌano aꞌadaro.
Vaze nuꞌe ani obone tihi reiro, rehano vazeni ꞌahoganiꞌa ani rana ꞌevore mene tiro.
Vaze Boroboroꞌa Iesu mazao Mene Firo
Ebu kuru neḡa uti azaḡaniꞌa dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Farisea azaḡa vaḡe bare onamiro. Ebu zeꞌa uti azaḡa ḡadiziro, “Za nougadu ani mene obone teadu tutune areha?”
Zeḡeꞌa naenaeziro, “Vaze ꞌadi teige ḡoere manoḡa ḡoeriroteꞌe vazaḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa!”
Farisea azaḡaniꞌa ziro, “Zae zuni aniꞌa soꞌozahe?
Vaze ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ga Farisea azaḡa boꞌaḡano ani mazao fieꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoga eꞌehe? Mene!
Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa ꞌahiꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa aḡuꞌa ꞌahine, ani mazao fieꞌohe. Eꞌanoꞌo ze radiu tuḡutuḡu adugaḡa hidiꞌuma!”
Ibite Iesu vaḡe onamiroteꞌe vazeḡa, Nikodemo zuni Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoga. Aniꞌa ḡadiziro,
“Emeḡe goro idunaḡano, emeꞌe vaze ḡoere egadu aniꞌa nagini haḡaeꞌeteꞌe ꞌizema ederogano aniꞌe veꞌoḡa rae mene raꞌohe.”
ꞌOugadu zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Ḡae zuni Galilea vazeḡahe? Buka Zaḡoḡa bare meꞌodoꞌi, ꞌougine peroveta vazeḡani ꞌahoga Galilea habaꞌano mene fureruꞌetaꞌaꞌe ederiꞌuma.”
Ebu ze zeḡezeḡe ne oname ḡouriro.
